difference_from_nearest: CADRE certifies a compressed DRE ranking margin and optionally decompresses; PCFDLW certifies recursive state representations before model selection by realized decision regret
mechanism_removing_comparator: DLEW selection over all candidates without closure/fidelity certification
new_failure_mode: a candidate has excellent immediate downstream decision loss but its compressed state is not predictively closed for recursive deployment
non_additive_interaction: PCFT certification changes the candidate set on which DLEW optimizes realized regret
